🚀 Mega Update (v1.0.3) by Dhiraj:
• 📥 WhatsApp Status Saver: Save HD photos & videos directly to gallery with full-screen preview & 1-tap save/share
• 🎙️ Deleted Voice Note Recovery: Automatically capture and preserve deleted WhatsApp voice notes with built-in audio player (Play/Pause, seekbar, timer)
• 📄 Export Chat to PDF: Convert your full chat history into professionally formatted A4 PDF documents with 1-tap sharing
• 100% Data Preservation: All your existing saved messages and media remain intact
